A '''Moff''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] owned a [[Unidentified Moff's yacht|personal yacht]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3668 BBY]], the [[Moff/Legends|Moff's]] yacht was stolen by a Republic strike team, who used the yacht to board the [[Dread Masters' dreadnaught|dreadnaught]] that ferried the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]].
